name: Webflow
description_en:
Webflow is a hosted visual website platform with layout/design tools, CMS, interactions and collaboration. It also offers Webflow Cloud for applications alongside sites, plus separately priced analytics, optimization and localization. A Site plan governs an individual website’s hosting/capabilities; a Workspace plan governs staging and collaboration, and paid Workspaces enable code export.

Evaluate the actual site, team and runtime requirements together. The current public pricing uses Basic/Premium and Team/Enterprise labels alongside older labels in some table headings, so this draft preserves that naming inconsistency and does not reuse older CMS/Business plan assumptions. Static export is a limited exit path, not a copy of hosted dynamic services.
description_zh:
Webflow 是提供布局/设计、CMS、交互和协作的托管可视化网站平台。它还有在站点旁运行应用的 Webflow Cloud，以及独立收费的分析、优化和本地化。Site 方案控制单个网站的托管/能力，Workspace 控制暂存与协作，付费 Workspace 才可导出代码。

应一起评估站点、团队和运行需求。当前公开定价使用 Basic/Premium、Team/Enterprise 名称，部分表头仍有旧称，因此本草稿保留命名不一致，不沿用旧 CMS/Business 方案假设。静态导出是有限退出路径，不能复制托管动态服务。

core_features.explanation_en: Design layouts and interactions, then manage structured content with plan-specific collections, items and API limits.
core_features.explanation_zh: 设计布局及交互，再按方案的集合、条目和 API 限制管理结构化内容。

core_features.name_zh: 独立站点与工作区方案
core_features.explanation_en: Paid Site hosting is per site; Workspace staging/collaboration and code export are separate entitlements unless bundled in a Platform contract.
core_features.explanation_zh: 付费 Site 托管按站收费，Workspace 暂存/协作及代码导出是独立权利，Platform 合同打包另计。

core_features.explanation_en: Cloud app bandwidth is pooled with site bandwidth, with request/CPU/storage limits and documented overage units.
core_features.explanation_zh: Cloud 应用带宽与站点池共享，请求/CPU/存储有上限，并记录超额计费单位。

pricing.summary_en: Free limited Starter; Site Basic/Premium starts $15/$25 per month billed yearly, with extra capacity. Paid Workspaces and add-ons separate; Team Platform $2,500/month annual contract. Export requires paid Workspace, not only Site.
pricing.summary_zh: Starter 有限免费；Site Basic/Premium 年付月均起价 $15/$25，扩容另费。付费 Workspace 及附加项分开，Team Platform $2,500/月年度合同。导出要求付费 Workspace，仅 Site 不够。

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Define the site and publishing responsibilities
sections.en: Use Starter to prototype a small site on webflow.io, inspect the visual layout and responsive interactions, and test one CMS pattern if needed. The free Site allowance is two static pages, 1GB monthly bandwidth and 50 form submissions per site; these are not unlimited production resources. A free Workspace includes two staging sites and one full seat, independent of paid hosted sites. For a marketing team, decide who edits content, controls design and publishes before handing over access. The homepage’s page-branching/governance descriptions do not establish those features on every entry plan. No Designer, account or publishing workflow was executed here.
sections.zh: 可用 Starter 在 webflow.io 上做小站原型，检查布局和响应式交互，并按需验证一种 CMS 模式。免费 Site 含两张静态页、每月 1GB 带宽及每站 50 次表单提交，不是无限生产资源。免费 Workspace 含两个暂存站和一个完整席位，与付费托管站点分开。营销团队交接前应明确内容编辑、设计控制和发布责任。首页的页面分支/治理描述不证明每个入门档均有这些能力。本次未操作 Designer、账户或发布流程。

sections.title_en: Budget the current Site plan and traffic tier
sections.title_zh: 核算当前 Site 及流量档
sections.en: Current USD before-tax cards show Basic $15/month billed yearly for non-CMS sites, with custom domain, 300 static pages and 10GB monthly bandwidth. Premium starts at $25/month billed yearly for CMS/content-rich sites, with a 50GB base and selectable capacity levels up to 2.5TB. Additional 50GB is listed at $20/month annual billing or $30 monthly; higher bundles differ. The matrix lists Premium 20,000 CMS items, 40 collections and 120 management-API requests/minute, but some headings still say CMS/Premier. Confirm the actual purchased tier. Two consecutive over-limit months can trigger automatic upgrades under surge protection; do not treat burst tolerance as permanently free capacity.
sections.zh: 当前税前美元卡片显示，非 CMS Basic 年付月均 $15，含自定义域名、300 静态页、每月 10GB 带宽。CMS/内容型 Premium 年付月均起价 $25，基础 50GB，可选至 2.5TB。额外 50GB 年付月均 $20、月付 $30，更大包不同。表格列出 Premium 20,000 CMS 条目、40 集合及每分钟 120 次管理 API 请求，但部分表头仍写 CMS/Premier，需确认实际购买档。surge protection 下连续两月超限可触发自动升级，突发容忍不能当作永久免费容量。

sections.title_en: Add the Workspace or Platform costs deliberately
sections.title_zh: 明确工作区或 Platform 费用
sections.en: Team Workspaces list Core $19/month and Growth $49, billed yearly, with 10 versus unlimited staging sites. Freelancer/Agency Workspaces display $16/$35 monthly equivalents annually; the Agency card says three client seats per site while its detailed client-access row still says one, so confirm that allowance. A paid Workspace does not replace the custom-domain Site plan. The Team Platform package starts at $2,500/month with an annual contract, bundling Site/Workspace and selected controls; it is not the price of an ordinary team seat. Optimize starts at $299/month by page views, Analyze $9 by sessions and Localize $9/$29 by locale tier. Exact usage selection and extra seats can change cost.
sections.zh: 团队 Workspace 年付月均 Core $19、Growth $49，对应 10 个和不限暂存站。Freelancer/Agency 年付月均 $16/$35，Agency 卡片写每站三个客户席位，详细客户访问行仍写一个，需确认额度。付费 Workspace 不能替代自定义域名 Site 方案。Team Platform 起价 $2,500/月、要求年度合同，打包 Site/Workspace 及部分控制，并非普通团队席位价格。Optimize 按页面浏览量起价 $299/月，Analyze 按会话量 $9，Localize 按语言档 $9/$29。实际用量和额外席位会改变费用。

sections.title_en: A Cloud app has compute and storage costs
sections.title_zh: Cloud 应用有计算及存储成本
sections.en: The current Cloud table pools app bandwidth with the site allowance. Starter/Basic list five apps, one million requests/month and 15 CPU minutes; Premium lists 15 apps, two million requests and 30 CPU minutes, followed by metered usage. The FAQ quotes $2 per million extra requests and $2 per five CPU hours. D1/KV/R2 storage and operations have separate limits and overages; unlimited database count is not unlimited storage or execution. Confirm the chosen site/app-project billing model, deployment compatibility, database recovery and external API costs. These sources establish advertised capacity, not a performance or security benchmark.
sections.zh: 当前 Cloud 表将应用带宽与站点额度合并。Starter/Basic 列出五个应用、每月一百万请求和 15 CPU 分钟；Premium 为 15 应用、两百万请求和 30 CPU 分钟，之后按量计费。FAQ 报额外每百万请求 $2、每五 CPU 小时 $2。D1/KV/R2 存储和操作各有限额/超额费，数据库数量不限不代表存储或执行无限。应确认站点/应用项目计费模式、部署兼容性、数据库恢复和外部 API 成本。这些来源确认广告容量，不是性能或安全基准。

sections.title_en: Export static assets and rebuild dynamic services
sections.title_zh: 导出静态资源并重建动态服务
sections.en: The export guide requires a paid Workspace, not merely a paid Site. Use Main menu → Code export → Prepare ZIP. Its exclusions include CMS/eCommerce/user-account data and behavior, code components and localized content; forms/search stop working and page passwords are removed. Data collections require separate exports. It permits editing exported code, but warns changes can break components. The pricing FAQ adds that exported code cannot be reimported. Plan replacements before moving a dynamic site. Code export does not establish an open-source license to Webflow’s platform. Cancellation does not erase payment obligations for the signed term. No export, external-host deployment, Cloud app, checkout or CMS/API call was tested.
sections.zh: 导出指南要求付费 Workspace，仅付费 Site 不够。路径为 Main menu → Code export → Prepare ZIP。排除 CMS/电商/用户账户数据及行为、代码组件和本地化内容，表单/搜索停止工作，页面密码移除，数据集合需另行导出。指南允许修改导出代码，但提醒可能破坏组件。定价 FAQ 另称导出代码不能重新导入。迁移动态站前应规划替代服务；代码导出不等于 Webflow 平台开源许可。取消不免除已签期限付款义务。本次未实测导出、外部托管、Cloud 应用、结账或 CMS/API 调用。

research_gaps.en: Current mixed plan headings and Agency one-versus-three client-seat rows need confirmation, as do selected bandwidth, extra seats, Cloud database recovery and checkout totals.
research_gaps.zh: 当前混合方案表头及 Agency 一个/三个客户席位差异需确认，所选带宽、额外席位、Cloud 数据库恢复及结账总额也需核对。

research_gaps.en: No visual editor, staging/publishing, code export, Cloud application, data API or independent migration was tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未实测可视化编辑器、暂存/发布、代码导出、Cloud 应用、数据 API 或独立迁移。
